about: Allow-list of the simulation service (.kiro/specs/simulation-service). Owner decision 2026-11-09: no individualised simulation; every run is over a predefined virtual population and every result is a distribution (median and band), never one person's value. Only these compound and population ids are accepted; the httk chemical name and every model parameter come from this file and from data/time_machine/compartmental_pk.csv, never from a request. Validation figures are the time machine's (.kiro/specs/time-machine/design.md section 8.1). Virtual population, for research. Not about any person and not a dose recommendation.

populations.basis: the cited parameters (Faulkner 1986, 12 young healthy volunteers) with the cited spreads; the clearance spread is a judgement that already covers the older-versus-younger difference

clearance scaled by 19/25, the older-versus-younger amlodipine clearance of Abernethy 1990 (hypertensive patients, mean age 68), applied on top of the same spreads; other parameters unchanged (Abernethy's half-lives 58 vs 42 h imply an almost unchanged volume); ages 80 and over are not covered

compartmental.dose_basis: amlodipine base; fixed bounds of this model, from a quarter of the validation dose to the validation dose
compartmental.validated_scope: one 10 mg oral dose in healthy volunteers (Soria-Chacartegui 2023)

scenarios.note: the whole hydroxyanthracene content counted as free rhein (an upper estimate: mostly glycosides, no colonic activation in the model); one historical dose attributed to al-Khuzi; machine translation

populations.basis: the cited apparent parameters (Magnard 1993, healthy volunteers) with the cited spreads; bioavailability fixed at 1 because the parameters are already apparent; no data on older adults was verified, so no older-adult population is offered

compartmental.dose_basis: mg rhein equivalent; fixed bounds of this model, from a quarter of the validation dose to the Canon scenario's midpoint
compartmental.validated_scope: one 38.58 mg (rhein equivalent, as 50 mg diacerein) oral dose in healthy volunteers; only the peak is an independent check

httk_populations.basis: HTTK-Pop virtual individuals resampled from NHANES 2013-2018, ages 20-50 (Ring et al. 2017)
HTTK-Pop virtual individuals resampled from NHANES 2013-2018, ages 65-79; HTTK-Pop has no record above 79, so 80+ is never simulated (Ring et al. 2017; time-machine DP-T10)

httk_comparison.basis: both HTTK-Pop age ranges in one run; the older-to-younger ratio of medians is the result (time-machine design section 7.4); absolute concentrations failed validation and are not a level anyone has (1 mg/kg/day is far above usual doses of these drugs)
